content: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
author: Mark Twain
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

Mark Twain understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
